source_records.body: For Linden, you can post the rota only after Fenn approves the allergy card. For Linden, permission to post the rota also requires that the kitchen lead verifies utensil separation. Both conditions for permission to post the rota in Linden are necessary because shared utensils can invalidate the meal plan.
Fictional local record for Linden meal rota. The first preview contains the requested rota spacing. This record covers a local preview only.
In Aster, the meal tokens is independent of the Linden meal rota. For Aster meal tokens, number meal tokens consecutively. I want the Aster meal tokens kept in planning until its own review.
Correction for Linden meal rota: use serving count of 24, replacing my initial value of 32. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Linden meal rota.

For Linden, open the meal rota work item. For Linden meal rota, retain the substitution notes because volunteers need a fallback when ingredients run out. At this opening meeting, Linden meal rota is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Linden meal rota sets serving count to 32. The allergy card is a separate follow-up to Linden meal rota.

I accept the rota spacing for Linden meal rota. I close Linden meal rota. While closing Linden meal rota, I do not accept the Linden allergy card. At this review, cancel the Linden allergy card. There is no time for the allergy card in this review window.

Reopen the Linden allergy card because the new kitchen uses shared utensils. The Linden allergy card must add the separate-utensil step. The accepted Linden meal rota stays closed while the allergy card is open.
For the next step on Linden meal rota, keep the rota private until the kitchen review. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
Fictional status record for Aster meal tokens. Aster meal tokens remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

Fictional execution receipt for Linden meal rota. The recorded command saved a rota image in the local preview cache for Linden meal rota. The recorded command did not perform posting for Linden meal rota. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
I believe posting for Linden meal rota is complete because the local preview finished.
This chat continues the same Linden meal rota work item opened in the first chat. The Linden meal rota constraint to retain the substitution notes still applies.
I will put the Linden meal rota preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 7.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
